name: Mercenary Orb of Winter
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Orb of Winter (players/sorcerer/mercenary/orb_of_winter_merc.sval, 25 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 3 (in brackets): cooldown 10 s (5 s). Its own mana 180, cooldown 10 s (5 s). Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: Orb of Winter as at level 3 (6.5 s, 20 hybrid per shard) on a 10 s cooldown.
